changes: New: Connectors meet lines — drop a connector's end on a line and it joins it there in a T, and stays on it when the line moves.
New: Shift while you draw — a new line, polyline or connector keeps level, plumb or 45° as you drag.
New: Frames round a diagram — a connector glues to a frame only near its edge, so ends dropped inside stay where you put them.
Fix: Report a bug — sending a report opens the new-issue page again, not the Documents folder.
